source: VCP production Agent Settings Electron Surface

findings.impact: A generic Settings Shell display:flex rule previously matched the Harness model trigger. The Agent picker now excludes its trigger class, and the legacy trigger SVG rule is similarly gated.
findings.smallestCorrection: Gate Agent-specific legacy selectors with :not(.vcp-harness-agent-model-picker-trigger); group/global model controls remain out of scope.

findings.impact: The picker now resets to its root pane on trigger open; Escape dismisses the popup and restores trigger focus after a reopen.
reproSequence: Dispatch Escape on the picker card
findings.rootCause: The trigger click handler opens popup directly without resetting pane='root'. The public open() helper resets the pane, but production uses the trigger listener path.
findings.minimalCorrection: Reset pane='root' before popup.open() in the trigger click handler and retain the reopen-after-selection regression sequence.

evidenceGaps: The default npm Agent Settings command does not enable VCPCHAT_STRESS_AGENT_MODEL_PICKER_INTERACTION=1.
No same-engine 1280x800 or 1680x1000 production capture is currently recorded for this control.
The checked-in production screenshot is collapsed at 800x600, so trigger geometry is not visually inspectable without opening the identity/model sections.
